record.one_liner: Paya Connect (Nuvei-owned) REST payments API for card and ACH transactions, vaults and recurring billing
record.auth_notes: Two methods on the auth page: user_id + user_api_key sent as headers, query params, or as Basic username/password; and a username/password token method via POST /v2/token. Every request also needs a developer-id.
record.access_notes: Sandbox host api.sandbox.payaconnect.com is documented, but the API page says the service is for approved entities and production credentials are issued only after a certification step (sdksupport@nuvei.com). How sandbox credentials are obtained was not seen on the fetched pages.
record.api_notes: Docs list endpoints for account vaults, contacts, recurrings, router transactions, signatures, quick invoices, level3 data, location info, post-back configs and more.
record.blocker_notes: Production use needs the certification step before new credentials are issued. Hint says NMI-powered, but no NMI reference appeared on the Paya Connect pages fetched; the NMI pages found belong to NMI itself and were not tied to this product. No official or community MCP server found in search.
